extraction.Name: Martha Irving
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment for the reason that she did not want to pay any taxes on the land; but, on the advice of her farmer and the people in the Indian Office, at Pine Ridge, she accepted the patent in fee
extraction.Buyer: sold to Mr. Joe Leedom, of Gordon Nebraska, for $5100.00, in 1921
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: not wishing to pay taxes on this allotment, and, receiving a cash offer of $5100.00, in 1921, from Mr. Joe Leedom, of Gordon Nebraska, she accepted this offer
extraction.NOTES: No. 63; husband managed the business of the land sale and looks after some of her business at present; she looks after some of it herself; health is good, but husband is in the last stages of tuberculosis and has been suffering from same for the last six years, hence he is not able to earn anything; they have nine minor children, all of whom are depending upon her for support; has never received any aid from the County or Government; document sworn November 10, 1928, County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | TASK 5 PHRASING-HOLDOUT ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-30: Source page header 'No. NNNN' is the allotment number, captured by Sonnet in NOTES as a 'document reference' / 'document numbered' / bare 'No. NNNN' (alternate phrasings of the same Pine Ridge typewritten affidavit pattern). User source-page review confirmed. Applied alongside the 48-record bulk allotment recovery batch.
